items.headline: He birdied his way into the playoffs — Michael Brennan wins the Wyndham
items.body: Brennan closed with a 64, including five straight birdies, to win by three at 22-under and snag the very last ticket into the FedExCup Playoffs. It's already his second PGA Tour title of the year.
items.say: Did you catch the Wyndham? This kid Brennan basically birdied his way into the playoffs on the final Sunday.

items.headline: Arsenal just paid a record fee for a midfielder — Bruno Guimarães is a Gunner
items.body: Arsenal signed Newcastle captain Bruno Guimarães for a reported £75m — no midfielder over 28 has ever cost more — dropping a Brazil international into the engine room of a title-chasing side right before kickoff.
items.say: Arsenal splashing £75m on Bruno Guimarães — you reckon that's finally the midfield that wins them the league?

items.headline: Coco Gauff is rolling in Toronto — into the quarters without breaking a sweat
items.body: Gauff dropped just four games in a 6-3, 6-1 win to reach her first Canadian Open quarterfinal since 2023. Belinda Bencic — who ended Cinderella Alexandra Eala's run — is next, with Osaka and Rybakina also through. Prime US Open tune-up.
items.say: Coco's cruising at the Canadian Open — big US Open tune-up. You following the hard-court swing?

items.headline: Tatis went yard off the warehouse — Padres knock off the AL West-leading Astros
items.body: Fernando Tatis Jr.'s two-out, three-run bomb — a 421-foot shot off Petco's iconic brick warehouse in left — sank Houston 7-2, and new Padre Austin Hays homered in his first at-bat. San Diego has won 12 of 16 and sits a game out of a playoff spot.
items.say: Tatis launched one off the warehouse at Petco — Padres are red-hot heading into the stretch run.

items.headline: Real football's (almost) back — NFL preseason Week 1 kicks off Thursday
items.body: Sixteen games across three nights (Aug 13-15) give the first live look at this year's rookie class and a wave of newly-acquired stars suiting up in new colors — including Raiders No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza pushing for reps.
items.say: Preseason starts Thursday — got a rookie you're actually excited to finally see in pads?

items.headline: BTS are back on stage — and the 'ARIRANG' tour is hitting US stadiums
items.body: With military service behind them, all seven members reunited for their first tour in years — and it's enormous: 85-plus dates across 34 cities on a 360° in-the-round stage. Arlington's AT&T Stadium gets them this weekend.
items.say: BTS are finally touring again after the army — they're playing stadiums over here right now.

items.headline: Shane Gillis is back at the auto shop — 'Tires' Season 3 lands Thursday
items.body: Netflix's chaotic workplace comedy returns Aug 13, with Will and Shane now co-owners trying (and mostly failing) to keep Valley Forge Auto afloat. It's quietly become one of the platform's biggest comedy hits.
items.say: New season of Tires drops Thursday — that Shane Gillis show is dumb in the best possible way.

items.headline: Rockstar's teasing GTA VI again — a new 'Extended Look' drops Aug 27
items.body: Grand Theft Auto VI, arguably the most anticipated game ever, gets a fresh 'Extended Look' premiering on Netflix and YouTube on Aug 27. Until then, Trailer 2 — already one of the most-watched trailers in history — is the thing to rewatch.
items.say: Rockstar's dropping a new GTA VI look on the 27th — the hype for this game is genuinely unreal.

items.headline: Morgan Wallen won't leave No. 1 — 'I'm the Problem' is back on top
items.body: Wallen's record-smashing album 'I'm the Problem' climbed back to the summit of the Billboard 200 this week, extending a ridiculously dominant run atop the chart in a monster year for country music.
items.say: Morgan Wallen's album is back at No. 1 again — the guy has basically lived at the top of the charts all year.
